New Director: Apryle Oswald
On August 24, 2026, we welcomed Apryle Oswald to Ivy II’s Board of Directors
Apryle Oswald Ivy II Board of Directors

items: As a reminder, the list below details the current members

blocks.text: of Ivy II’s Board of Directors

blocks.html: Apryle Oswald is a reinsurance executive and actuary with 25 years of experience in the Bermuda reinsurance industry. Most recently, she served as Chief Analytics Officer at Ariel Re, where she was also a member of both the Board of Directors and the Risk Committee. Previously, she held positions as lead portfolio manager at Nephila Capital, Vice President and Underwriter at RenaissanceRe, and Director of Actuarial Services at KPMG in Bermuda.
blocks.text: Apryle Oswald is a reinsurance executive and actuary with 25 years of experience in the Bermuda reinsurance industry. Most recently, she served as Chief Analytics Officer at Ariel Re, where she was also a member of both the Board of Directors and the Risk Committee. Previously, she held positions as lead portfolio manager at Nephila Capital, Vice President and Underwriter at RenaissanceRe, and Director of Actuarial Services at KPMG in Bermuda.

blocks.html: Her experience spans actuarial, underwriting, and portfolio management, and has included the development of pricing and exposure management systems, capital allocation, third-party cash management, and investor education. Apryle is a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society and holds a Bachelor of Science in Actuarial Science from The Pennsylvania State University.
